test_title: PYST 41: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 24 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the word given in the brackets to fill in the blank.**

The university team won the match in the end with a _______________ (cunning) move.
solution: The correct answer is **'slick'**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Cunning **is an adjective that means having or showing skill in achieving one's ends by deceit or evasion.(छल या चोरी से अपना लक्ष्य प्राप्त करने में कौशल रखना या दिखाना) • The meaning of the given options are as follows - • **Brilliant**- someone exceptionally clever or talented.(असाधारण रूप से चतुर या प्रतिभाशाली।) • **Slick**- someone clever at persuading people but perhaps not completely honest, skillful, and effective but in a clever manner.(कोई व्यक्ति लोगों को अपनी बात समझाने में चतुर है लेकिन शायद पूरी तरह से ईमानदार, कुशल और प्रभावी नहीं बल्कि चतुर तरीके से) • **Random**- something made, done, or happening without method or conscious decision.(बिना विधि या सचेत निर्णय के कुछ किया, किया या घटित होना) • **Quick**- moving fast or doing something in a short time.(तेजी से आगे बढ़ना या कम समय में कुछ करना) • From the above meanings it is evident that **slick **is the correct synonym for the word **cunning**. • Hence, **option 2 **is the most appropriate synonym of the word given in the brackets to fill in the blank. **Correct sentence__ - ***The university team won the match in the end with a **__slick__ **(cunning) move.* 38:T5f5, The correct answer is 'Get ready for'.
